column1: # Harvested from the 5,346-patent corpus and passed through attest.py, 2026-09-04.
# All of these clear the independence test: copy_factor near or below 1.0 and
# top_share under 30%, i.e. the documents assert them in their own words rather
# than repeating one copied passage. `celery` was the specific worry and it is clean.
# THEY ARE NOT ADMITTED, and the reason is the molecules column. The best of them
# reaches 7 molecules from patents and 8 from PubChem; the bar is 30. Adding all 28
# would move the score from 17-of-67 to 17-of-95 — the same tags at the bar, a worse
# denominator, and 28 new tags to fill. The binding constraint has been molecules,
# not vocabulary, since 2026-08-05 and this run does not change that.
# Revisit when the molecule count per existing tag is comfortably past 30. Then these
# are a ready, evidenced shortlist and no re-harvest is needed.
